info.title: VistaLink API
info.description: VistaLink hotel API v2. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer vl_live_…` (or `vl_test_…`). Money is a decimal string with a sibling ISO 4217 `currency`. Every response carries `request_id` and `billing` (null when free); errors are `{error: {code, message, request_id, details?}}`. Rate-limit headers `X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset`, credit header `X-Credit-Remaining` (USD).
info.summary: Hotel resolution, search, content, rates, room reconciliation, booking and email quotes.

post.description: Free and synchronous; needs the `search` scope. Up to 500 identifiers (a listing URL in `booking_url`, the hotel's own `website_url`, an `expedia_url`, or `name` + `city` + `country`) come back as one result each, in request order. An input that does not resolve carries its `status` and `reason` instead of failing the call.

get.description: Synchronous; needs the `content` scope and bills `hotel.detail` once per call. post.description: Synchronous; needs the `search` scope. Send a natural-language `query`, structured `filters`, or both; at least one of `query`, `filters.location`, `filters.near` or `filters.hotel_ids` is required. Billed per call: a `query` makes it loose (else structured) and `ranking` picks filters or semantic, giving `search.structured.filters`, `search.loose.filters`, `search.structured.semantic` or `search.loose.semantic`, plus `search.extra_results` for each result beyond 10. Further pages of the same `search_id` are free, and a `needs_clarification` response is free; answer it with `{search_id, answers}`.

post.summary: Rates for many hotels and stays
post.description: Always a job: answers 202 with a `rates.batch` job; needs the `rates` scope and the Build plan or higher (a Free plan's test key may try `freshness: cached` with up to 25 hotels and 1 stay). Billed at the `POST /v2/rates` unit prices for each hotel and stay that comes back priced, 25% off when the batch has 1,000 hotels or more. The result is NDJSON at `result_url`, one line per hotel and stay in the `results[]` shape of `POST /v2/rates` with its `stay`, plus a `summary`. The 10 cheapest available offers of each line can be booked with `POST /v2/bookings` for 30 minutes; re-quote any other offer with `POST /v2/rates`. Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

post.description: Answers 202 with the Booking, which then moves on its own: poll GET /v2/bookings/{booking_id} or subscribe to `booking.updated`. Needs the `booking` scope and an `Idempotency-Key`; bookings are free and `billing` is always null. Live booking is in early access (request it from sales@vistalink.com; until then live keys answer 403 `not_yet_available`) and then needs the Build plan. Any `vl_test_` key, Free included, gets the full booking sandbox: it simulates every outcome and never contacts a hotel or charges a card. Payment `mode` is `checkout` (a hosted checkout link in `payment.checkout_url`, where the guest pays the property directly), `handoff` (a hosted session for the guest) or `external` (the booking engine's own prefilled page). `card_entry` answers 403 `not_yet_available` for a live key until it is enabled for the account (test keys run it in the sandbox): it needs `payment_method` and `mandate`, answers `requires_credential`, and nothing touches the hotel until `POST /v2/bookings/{booking_id}/confirm`.

post.summary: Request a quote from a hotel
post.description: Answers 202 with the Quote; VistaLink then emails the hotel, from its own address and on behalf of a guest it does not name, for a direct price on the stay. Most hotels reply within 6 hours, some take a day: poll GET /v2/quotes/{quote_id} or subscribe to `quote.updated`. Costs $0.25 per quote the hotel answers with a price, charged once when the first priced offer arrives (reserved from your credit now, released when the quote closes without one); nothing when the hotel declines or does not reply. Needs the `quotes` scope, the Build plan or higher and an `Idempotency-Key`. Test keys never email anyone and cost nothing, on every plan, Free included: a simulated hotel answers within seconds, as `sandbox_outcome` says.

status.description: Where the booking is: `queued`, `processing`, `requires_payment` (show `payment.checkout_url`), `requires_user_action` (send the guest to `handoff.url`), then `confirmed`, `confirmation_pending` (submitted, confirmation not yet seen), `failed`, `expired` or `canceled`. Only `card_entry` bookings also use `requires_credential` (waiting for confirm), `submitted` (the hotel's pay button was pressed), `requires_action` (see `next_action`) and `unknown` (submitted, outcome not yet provable: tell the guest not to book again and to check their email from the hotel).

offer.description: The offer being booked, as it was when the booking was created.

revalidation.description: The result of re-checking the offer on the engine; null until that check has an outcome.

handoff.description: Where the guest finishes the booking in `handoff` and `external` modes; null in `checkout` mode and before the engine step.

confirmation.description: The hotel's confirmation; null until `status` is `confirmed`.

payment.description: The guest's payment; null for `external` mode and for `checkout` until the link is issued.

failure.description: Why the booking failed or expired; null otherwise.

commission.description: Commission terms once the booking is confirmed; null before that.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Every status the booking has been in, oldest first, starting with `queued` (`requires_credential` for `card_entry`).

version.title: Version
version.description: `card_entry` only: goes up by one on every change; apply a `booking.updated` event only when its `data.version` is higher than the last one you saw.

payment_method.description: `card_entry` only: the card's brand, last four and expiry.

charges.description: `card_entry` only: the total the hotel's checkout showed.

submitted_at.title: Submitted At
submitted_at.description: `card_entry` only: when the hotel's pay button was pressed. Once set, the booking is never resubmitted and cannot be canceled.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: `card_entry` only: in `requires_credential`, the deadline to confirm; null otherwise.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description:
A booking and everything that has happened to it. Returned by create, get and cancel, and
as `data` in `booking.updated`.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The engine's total, a decimal string.

mismatch.title: Mismatch
mismatch.description: True when the engine reported a charge above `mandate.max_total` after submit; ops is alerted.

BookingCharges.title: BookingCharges
BookingCharges.description: `card_entry` only: the amount the hotel's checkout showed, read in code, never typed by a model.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Stable failure code: `sold_out`, `price_changed` (revalidation, or with `card_entry` the hotel's checkout total was above the accepted total; nothing was typed), `price_changed_at_payment` (the engine charged a different total after checkout), `engine_blocked`, `handoff_expired` (the guest left the session), `payment_expired`, `payment_failed`, `unsupported_engine` (the engine or offer cannot be booked in this mode), `payment_unavailable` (hosted checkout is not available; use `handoff`). `card_entry` only: `card_declined` (the hotel's checkout declined the card; create a new booking with a new credential), `three_d_secure_failed`, `card_entry_failed` (stopped before the pay button; nothing was charged), `card_entry_unavailable` (card entry is not available for this engine right now), and `mandate_expired` on `expired` (not confirmed within 30 minutes).

message.title: Message
message.description: One English sentence explaining the failure.

BookingFailure.title: BookingFailure
BookingFailure.description:
Why a booking ended without a reservation. Present when `status` is `failed`, and on
`expired` with `payment_expired`.

room.title: Room
room.description: Zero-based index into `stay.rooms`; every room needs exactly one entry.

lead.description: The room's lead guest, whose name, email and phone go on the reservation.

occupants.title: Occupants
occupants.description: Other guests in the room, up to 16; kept with the booking but not sent to the engine.

BookingGuests.title: BookingGuests
BookingGuests.description: The guests of one room of the stay.

accepted_total.title: Accepted Total
accepted_total.description: The total the guest accepted, in `currency`.

max_total.title: Max Total
max_total.description: The most the hotel's checkout may show before the card is typed; equals `accepted_total`.

consent_at.title: Consent At
consent_at.description: When the guest approved, as you sent it.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: The mandate's deadline: confirm before it, 30 minutes after create.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The payment mode the booking was created with.

status.title: Status
status.description: `pending` until the guest pays, then `completed`, `expired` (link or session timed out, or the booking was canceled first) or `failed`; it never changes after leaving `pending`.

checkout_url.title: Checkout Url
checkout_url.description: `checkout` only: the hosted checkout link to show the guest; null in `handoff` mode.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: `checkout` only: when the checkout link stops working, about 30 minutes after it is issued; null in `handoff` mode.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: What the guest pays, the offer's total as a decimal string in `currency`.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the payment completed, RFC 3339 UTC; null until then.

refund_required.title: Refund Required
refund_required.description: True when the guest's checkout payment completed and the booking will not be made, so the payment must be reversed by the checkout provider: canceled before the engine step, failed with `price_changed_at_payment`, or the amount paid did not match the booking (`payment_failed`); null otherwise.

BookingPayment.title: BookingPayment
BookingPayment.description:
The guest's payment. Null for `external` mode, and for `checkout` until the link is
issued.

BookingPaymentMethod.title: BookingPaymentMethod
BookingPaymentMethod.description: `card_entry` only: the card's metadata. Never the card number or CVC.

hotel_id.title: Hotel Id
hotel_id.description: The hotel being booked; must be the hotel the offer belongs to.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: An `offer_id` this key received from search, hotel detail, rates or chat in the last 30 minutes.

stay.description: The stay to book; must match the dates and party the offer was priced for.

guests.title: Guests
guests.description: One entry per room in `stay.rooms`, each with its lead guest.

special_requests.title: Special Requests
special_requests.description: Free-text requests from the guest, up to 2,000 characters; stored with the booking but not sent to the engine today.

webhook_url.title: Webhook Url
webhook_url.description: An https URL stored with the booking; `booking.updated` events are delivered only to webhooks created with `POST /v2/webhooks`, not here.

min.title: Min
min.description: Lowest acceptable price per room per night, a decimal string in `currency`; values of zero or less are ignored.

max.title: Max
max.description: Highest acceptable price per room per night, a decimal string in `currency`; values of zero or less are ignored.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: What the amounts cover; `per_room_per_night` is the only value.

BudgetFilter.title: BudgetFilter
BudgetFilter.description: A price band, matched against each hotel's catalogued room prices rather than live rates.

room_id.title: Room Id
room_id.description: Catalogue room id when the group includes a third-party channel listing; null otherwise.

name.title: Name
name.description: Room name, from the third-party channel listing when there is one, else from the first listing in the group.

size_m2.title: Size M2
size_m2.description: Room size in square metres; null when no source gives it.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Most guests the room holds; null when no source gives it.

bed_config.title: Bed Config
bed_config.description: Beds in the room; empty when no source gives them in a structured form.

CanonicalRoom.title: CanonicalRoom
CanonicalRoom.description:
The room as one record, taking each fact from the most authoritative source that has it
(your rooms, then the hotel's site, then other channels).

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or the country name when no code is known.

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address on one line, from street and number to country.

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: Straight-line distance in metres from `filters.near` or the landmark named in the query; null when the search had neither.

CardLocation.title: CardLocation
CardLocation.description: Where a hotel on a search card is.

status.title: Status
status.description: `observed` when seen recently (within 4 hours for stays in the next 14 days, else 24 hours), `stale` when older but within 7 days, `unknown` when there is no usable price and the other fields are null.

total.title: Total
total.description: Price for the whole stay and all rooms, a decimal string in `currency` with taxes and fees included where known.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the price was observed in; never converted.

nights.title: Nights
nights.description: Number of nights the total covers.

includes_taxes_and_fees.title: Includes Taxes And Fees
includes_taxes_and_fees.description: True when `total` includes taxes and fees, false when some are charged on top, null when unknown.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the price was observed: `direct` for the hotel's own booking engine, `third_party` for the Enterprise third-party channel.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the price was observed, RFC 3339 UTC.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: The offer behind this price, bookable with `POST /v2/bookings` for 30 minutes.

CardRate.title: CardRate
CardRate.description: The cheapest stored price for the stay on a search card. Never fetched live.

message.title: Message
message.description: What the traveller said, up to 4,000 characters.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Conversation to continue, a uuid from an earlier response; omit to start a new conversation.

guest_id.title: Guest Id
guest_id.description: Your id for the traveller, a uuid, recorded on a new conversation; ignored when `session_id` is set.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the assistant should talk in; card prices stay in the currency they were observed in.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language of the conversation as a language tag; `en` when omitted.

context.title: Context
context.description: Structured context passed to the assistant, for example a stay as `check_in`, `check_out`, `rooms` and `adults`; with a stay, hotel cards carry cached rates.

clarification_option_id.title: Clarification Option Id
clarification_option_id.description: The chosen option of that clarification.

user_location.description: The traveller's current position, for questions like 'near me'.

search_id.title: Search Id
search_id.description: Accepted for symmetry with search; not used as input.

examples.message: Somewhere quiet near the Pantheon for two nights in November

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Opaque id of this request, also sent as the `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when contacting support.

billing.description: What this call cost, or null when it was free.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Conversation id; send it back to continue the conversation.

message.title: Message
message.description: The assistant's reply in plain text.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.description: Hotels the reply refers to, up to 20, in the search card shape.

pois.title: Pois
pois.description: A place the turn located, as `{name, lat, lng, ...}`; at most one per turn.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Travel routes computed in the turn; always empty today.

references.title: References
references.description: Web sources cited in the turn as `{url, title, domain, index}`; always empty today.

clarification_pending.title: Clarification Pending
clarification_pending.description: A question the assistant needs answered, with `clarification_id`, `question` and `options[]`; null otherwise. Answer it with `clarification_id` and `clarification_option_id`.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: The reply split for rendering, each `{type, id}` plus `content` for `text`, `hotel_id` for `hotel_ref` or `hotel_ids` for `trip_suggestion`.

search_id.title: Search Id
search_id.description: A `search_id` for the hotels in this turn, valid for 30 minutes with `GET /v2/hotels/{hotel_id}?search_id=`; null when the turn returned no hotels.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Things the turn could not fully do, such as `rates_unavailable` or `channel_unavailable`.

examples.message: Here are three quiet options a short walk from the Pantheon.

id.title: Id
id.description: Clarification id to send back as `answers[].clarification_id`.

field.title: Field
field.description: The criterion that is ambiguous or missing; `location` (a city or landmark with several matches, or no place at all) is the only one asked today.

question.title: Question
question.description: The question to show the traveller, in English.

answer_type.title: Answer Type
answer_type.description: How to answer: `single_choice` (send one of `options` as `option_id`) or `free_text` (no options; send the traveller's answer as `value`, for example a city when the search named no place).

options.title: Options
options.description: The possible answers: at least two for `single_choice`, none for `free_text`.

Clarification.title: Clarification
Clarification.description: A question the search needs answered before it can run.

value.title: Value
value.description: The answer in the traveller's words, for a `free_text` question, for example `Lisbon`.

ClarificationAnswer.title: ClarificationAnswer
ClarificationAnswer.description: The answer to one clarification question.

id.title: Id
id.description: Option id to send back as `answers[].option_id`, for example `opt_gb`.

label.title: Label
label.description: What to show the traveller, for example `Cambridge, England`.

ClarificationOption.title: ClarificationOption
ClarificationOption.description: One possible answer to a clarification.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: `auto` returns `needs_clarification` with a question (free); `never` returns `partial` with no hotels and the ambiguous field in `resolved.unresolved` (also free).

ClarificationPolicy.title: ClarificationPolicy
ClarificationPolicy.description:
What to do when the request is ambiguous, for example a city name shared by several
places.

commissionable.title: Commissionable
commissionable.description: True when the hotel has an active commission contract covering today.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Commission as a decimal fraction string of the booking total, for example `"0.10"` for 10%; null when not commissionable or the contract has no rate.

partner_share.title: Partner Share
partner_share.description: Your share of the commission as a decimal fraction string, for example `"0.50"`; null when not commissionable.

Commission.title: Commission
Commission.description: Commission on a confirmed booking. Null until the booking is confirmed.

credential_id.title: Credential Id
credential_id.description: The `cred_` id to charge; omit it when it was sent as `payment_method.credential_id` at create. Must be active, unexpired, yours and not bound to another booking.

code.title: Code
code.description: The hotel's confirmation number; null when the engine confirmed without showing one.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: How the confirmation was established; `engine_confirmation_signal` (the engine's own confirmation page or code) is the only value produced today.

at.title: At
at.description: When the booking was confirmed, RFC 3339 UTC.

Confirmation.title: Confirmation
Confirmation.description:
Proof that the hotel's engine accepted the reservation. Present once `status` is
`confirmed`.

obtained_at.title: Obtained At
obtained_at.description: When the guest approved the summary (hotel, room, rate, dates, party, total and cancellation terms), RFC 3339; at most 15 minutes before the create call.

method.title: Method
method.description: `explicit_ui_confirmation` (a button on a screen showing the summary) or `explicit_chat_confirmation` (an agent turn that showed the summary and got a yes in that same turn).

cardholder_authorized.title: Cardholder Authorized
cardholder_authorized.description: Must be `true`: you attest that the guest is the cardholder, or is authorised to use the card, for this booking.

display_hash.title: Display Hash
display_hash.description: Optional `sha256:` hash of the canonical JSON you showed the guest; stored as evidence.

user_ref.title: User Ref
user_ref.description: Optional opaque id of the guest in your system; stored as evidence, never echoed.

Consent.title: Consent
Consent.description: `card_entry` only: your record that the cardholder approved this exact booking.

hotel_type.title: Hotel Type
hotel_type.description: Kind of property as catalogued, free text such as `hotel`; null when unknown.

star_rating.title: Star Rating
star_rating.description: Official star rating, 1 to 5; null when unrated.

review_score.title: Review Score
review_score.description: Average guest review score on a 0 to 10 scale; null when there are no reviews.

review_count.title: Review Count
review_count.description: Number of guest reviews behind `review_score`, which can differ from `reviews.count` (the reviews we hold).

description.title: Description
description.description: Long description of the hotel in `locale` when translated, else English; null when there is none.

short_character.title: Short Character
short_character.description: One line on what the hotel is like, from its published profile; null without a profile.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Hotel chain the property belongs to; null when independent or unknown.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Brand within the chain; null when none or unknown.

operating_status.title: Operating Status
operating_status.description: Whether the hotel is trading, for example `open`, `closed_temporarily`, `closed`, `opening_soon` or `unknown`; null without a profile.

check_in_time.title: Check In Time
check_in_time.description: Earliest check-in time, usually `HH:MM` in local time; null when unknown.

check_out_time.title: Check Out Time
check_out_time.description: Latest check-out time, usually `HH:MM` in local time; null when unknown.

booking_url.title: Booking Url
booking_url.description: The hotel's listing URL on the third-party channel; null when it has none.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: Uppercase amenity codes, as listed by `GET /v2/amenities`.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Languages the staff speak, as listed in the hotel profile, for example `en`; empty when unknown.

DetailCore.title: DetailCore
DetailCore.description: The hotel's identity, ratings and contact details.

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: Image id; the same image keeps the same id across responses.

url.title: Url
url.description: CDN URL of the image at `image_width` pixels wide (never upscaled).

label.title: Label
label.description: What the image shows, for example `building`, `room`, `bathroom` or `swimming pool outdoor`; null when unlabelled.

room_id.title: Room Id
room_id.description: The room this image shows, matching `rooms[].room_id`; null for images of the hotel as a whole.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width in pixels of the image at `url`; null when unknown.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height in pixels of the image at `url`; null when unknown.

position.title: Position
position.description: 1-based position in gallery order; null on `hero` and venue images.

DetailImage.title: DetailImage
DetailImage.description: An image on hotel detail, resized to `image_width`.

hero.description: The lead image; null when the hotel has no images.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many distinct images the hotel has, which can exceed the 50 in `items`.

items.title: Items
items.description: Up to 50 images in gallery order.

DetailImages.title: DetailImages
DetailImages.description: The hotel's gallery in curated order, without duplicates.

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address on one line: street and number, postcode, city.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or the country name when no code is known.

neighbourhood_text.title: Neighbourhood Text
neighbourhood_text.description: A paragraph on the neighbourhood, in `locale` when translated; null without a profile.

transport_notes.title: Transport Notes
transport_notes.description: How to get there by public transport, in `locale` when translated; null without a profile.

DetailLocation.title: DetailLocation
DetailLocation.description: Where the hotel is and how to get there.

stay.description: The stay the prices are for; null when no dates were given.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Prices per channel, direct first; empty without dates, for parties with children, or when nothing was observed.

refresh_job.description: The live rates job started by `rates=refresh`; its result arrives through `GET /v2/jobs/{job_id}` or the `rates.completed` webhook. Null otherwise.

DetailRates.title: DetailRates

Stored prices for the requested stay. Without `check_in` and `check_out` this is `{stay:
null, channels: []}`.

room_id.title: Room Id
room_id.description: Room id, stable across responses and used by `Offer.room_id`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Room description in `locale` when translated, else English; null when there is none.

size_m2.title: Size M2
size_m2.description: Room size in square metres; null when unknown.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Standard number of guests the room is sold for; null when unknown.

max_occupancy.title: Max Occupancy
max_occupancy.description: Most guests the room can hold, including extra beds; equals `occupancy` when no maximum is known.

bed_config.title: Bed Config
bed_config.description: Beds in the room; empty when unknown.

views.title: Views
views.description: Views from the room, for example `city` or `sea`.

balcony.title: Balcony
balcony.description: True when the room has a balcony or terrace, false when it does not, null when unknown.

accessible.title: Accessible
accessible.description: True when the room is wheelchair accessible, false when it is not, null when unknown.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.description: True when the room has a kitchen or kitchenette, false when it does not, null when unknown.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: Uppercase amenity codes of the room.

images.title: Images
images.description: Up to 6 images of the room.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: The same room on other channels, matched to this room.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Prices for this room for the requested stay; empty without dates or when none were observed.

DetailRoom.title: DetailRoom
DetailRoom.description: One physical room type, with its variants on other channels folded in.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel left out, `third_party`; set only on `channel_unavailable`.

DetailWarning.title: DetailWarning
DetailWarning.description: Something hotel detail could not fully do, without failing the call.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Engine code, as `Offer.engine` and `RateChannel.engine` report it, for example `SYNXIS`.

live_rates.title: Live Rates
live_rates.description: True when direct prices can be read live for hotels on this engine.

book.title: Book
book.description: True when bookings can be made on this engine.

success_class.title: Success Class
success_class.description: Measured booking success rate band: `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `unmeasured` (the value for every engine today).

hotel_count.title: Hotel Count
hotel_count.description: Indexed hotels on this engine; null when none or not counted.

Engine.title: Engine
Engine.description: A hotel booking engine we read prices from or book on.

request_id.description: Opaque id of this request, also sent as the `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when contacting support.

billing.description: What this call cost, or null when it was free.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable error code; the HTTP status follows from it (`bad_request` 400, `unauthorized` 401, `insufficient_credit` 402, `forbidden` 403, `not_found` 404, `conflict` 409, `rate_limited` 429, `upstream_error` 502, `unavailable` 503). ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The error itself: a stable `code`, a readable `message` and optional `details`.

per.title: Per

note.title: Note
note.description: Short note on how the charge is applied, for example `quoted on top of the total`.

ExcludedCharge.description: A charge quoted on top of an offer's `total`.

value.description: The fact itself as text, in `locale` when translated.

last_name.title: Last Name

email.title: Email
email.description: Lead guest's email address; the hotel's engine needs it for every reservation.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Lead guest's phone number, international format recommended; the hotel's engine needs it for every reservation.

praised.title: Praised

watch_outs.title: Watch Outs

GuestVoice.title: GuestVoice
GuestVoice.description: What guests praise and complain about, summarised from reviews.

url.title: Url
url.description: In `handoff` mode, the hosted browser session for the guest; in `external` mode, the booking engine's own prefilled page.

modes.

checks.title: Checks

HotelDetailResponse.description: Response of `GET /v2/hotels/{hotel_id}`. Sections not requested are null.

core.description: Boutique hotel near the Trevi Fountain.
core.name: Umiltà 36

booking_url.title: Booking Url
booking_url.description: An OTA listing URL of the form `https://www.booking.com/hotel/{cc}/{slug}.html`; matched on the listing slug.

website_url.title: Website Url
website_url.description: The hotel's own website; only the host is matched, so a bare domain works too.

expedia_url.title: Expedia Url
expedia_url.description: An Expedia listing URL carrying `.h{id}.`; answered `unsupported` until Expedia listings are indexed.

name.title: Name

city.title: City
city.description: City of the hotel named in `name`; required with `name`, not allowed without it.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the hotel named in `name`; narrows the name match, and a wrong value makes it miss.

HotelIdentifier.title: HotelIdentifier
HotelIdentifier.description:
A hotel named by something other than its `hotel_id`. Send exactly one form:
`booking_url`, `website_url`, `expedia_url`, or `name` with `city` (and ideally `country`).

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: Image id; the same image keeps the same id across responses.

url.title: Url
url.description: CDN URL of the image at 640 pixels wide.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the image shows, for example `building`, `room`, `bathroom` or `swimming pool outdoor`; null when unlabelled.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width in pixels of the image at `url`; null on `thumbnail` and when unknown.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height in pixels of the image at `url`; null on `thumbnail` and when unknown.

ImageRef.title: ImageRef
ImageRef.description: An image on a search card, resized to 640 pixels wide.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Id of the request that returned this job; null in lists and webhook payloads.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Job id, `job_` plus 12 letters and digits.

progress.description: Units of work done out of the total.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the job was created, RFC 3339 UTC; jobs expire 7 days later.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the job last changed, RFC 3339 UTC.

estimated_seconds.title: Estimated Seconds
estimated_seconds.description: Rough time the job was expected to take when it was created, in seconds.

result.title: Result
result.description: The outcome once `succeeded`: the `POST /v2/rates` response for `rates.live`, `{summary, lines, format, warnings}` for `rates.batch`, the reconcile result for `rooms.reconcile`. Null otherwise.

result_url.title: Result Url
result_url.description: `rates.batch` only: where to download the NDJSON result, a signed link or `GET /v2/jobs/{job_id}/result`; null for other kinds and until the job succeeds.

error.description: Why the job failed; null unless `status` is `failed`.

billing.description: What the job cost; null until it succeeds, and when nothing billable came back.

Job.title: Job
Job.description: Background work started by a 202 response. Also the `data` of the `*.completed` webhooks.

code.title: Code
code.description: Error code, one of the API error codes, usually `upstream_error`, `unavailable` (the job stopped and its held credit was returned) or `bad_request`.

details.title: Details
details.description: Structured reason and limits, when the underlying error supplies them.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Opaque id of this request, also sent as the `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when contacting support.

billing.description: What this call cost, or null when it was free.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Jobs on this page, newest first.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

total.title: Total
total.description: Units of work in the job: hotels for `rates.live`, hotel and stay pairs for `rates.batch`, 1 for `rooms.reconcile`.

JobProgress.title: JobProgress
JobProgress.description: How far a job has got.

city.title: City
city.description: City name, for example `Rome`; with no `country` an ambiguous city may come back as a clarification.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the city, for example `IT`.

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: A `resolved.location.place_id` from an earlier search, a slug of city and country such as `rome-it`.

LocationFilter.title: LocationFilter
LocationFilter.description:
Where to search: either `city` with `country`, or a `place_id` from an earlier response,
never both.

accepted_total.title: Accepted Total
accepted_total.description: The total the guest saw and accepted, a decimal string; must equal the offer's `total` to the cent. A higher engine total fails the booking with `price_changed` before the card is typed; a lower one goes ahead.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of `accepted_total`; must be the offer's.

consent.description: The guest's approval of this booking.

Mandate.title: Mandate
Mandate.description:
`card_entry` only: the total the guest accepted. We never press the hotel's pay button above
it.

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Latitude of the centre in decimal degrees.

lng.title: Lng
lng.description: Longitude of the centre in decimal degrees.

radius_m.title: Radius M
radius_m.description: Search radius in metres, 50 to 50,000; also the anchor for each card's `distance_m`.

NearFilter.title: NearFilter
NearFilter.description: A point and radius to search around; replaces any place named in `query`.

ambiguous.title: Ambiguous
ambiguous.description: True when another candidate scored as well, so neither could be chosen.

NearestListing.title: NearestListing
NearestListing.description: The closest candidate an unmatched listing had, below `min_confidence`.

type.title: Type
type.description: `three_d_secure_app`: tell the guest to approve the payment in their banking app; call nothing. `three_d_secure_otp`: the bank's challenge asks for a code the guest received; the challenge is watched until `expires_at` (a relay endpoint is not available yet).

cancelable.title: Cancelable
cancelable.description: Always false: the card was already submitted.

NextAction.title: NextAction
NextAction.description: `card_entry` only, non-null exactly when `status` is `requires_action`: what the guest must do.

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: Last day the notice applies, at midnight with no time zone; null when open-ended.

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description:
A temporary notice from the hotel, such as renovation work or a closed facility. Returned
with `core`.

children_ages.title: Children Ages
children_ages.description: Age of each child in the room; empty for adults only.

Occupancy.title: Occupancy
Occupancy.description: The party a price or stay is for, as returned.

Occupant.title: Occupant
Occupant.description:
Another guest in a room. Stored with the booking but not sent to the booking engine
today.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: Offer id, `off_t` plus 20 hex characters, specific to your account; book it with `POST /v2/bookings` within 30 minutes of receiving it.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Where the price was observed: `direct` for the hotel's own booking engine, `third_party` for the Enterprise third-party channel.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Code of the hotel's booking engine for direct offers, for example `SYNXIS`; null on the third-party channel.

room_id.title: Room Id
room_id.description: Catalogue room this offer is for, matching `rooms[].room_id` on hotel detail; null when the source names the room only by its own code or name.

room_name.title: Room Name
room_name.description: Room name as the source shows it; null when the source does not name the room.

listing_key.title: Listing Key
listing_key.description: The source's own key for the room, such as `engine_room:SUP` or `room_type:1234567`; null when the source has none.

rate_name.title: Rate Name
rate_name.description: Rate plan name as the source shows it, or one built from the cancellation terms and board, such as `Free cancellation, breakfast included`.

total.title: Total
total.description: Price for the whole stay and the whole party, a decimal string in `currency`; taxes the source quoted separately are added in when their amount is known. `"0"` when sold out.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the price was observed in; never converted.

nightly_avg.title: Nightly Avg
nightly_avg.description: `total` divided by the number of nights, for the whole party rather than per room; null when sold out.

includes_taxes.title: Includes Taxes
includes_taxes.description: True when `total` includes taxes and fees, false when some are listed in `excluded_charges`, null when the source does not say.

excluded_charges.title: Excluded Charges
excluded_charges.description: Charges payable on top of `total`; usually empty.

board.title: Board
board.description: Meals included: `none`, `breakfast`, `half` (breakfast and dinner), `full` (all meals) or `all_inclusive`; null when the source does not say.

free_cancellation.title: Free Cancellation
free_cancellation.description: True when the rate can be canceled free of charge, false when it is non-refundable, null when unknown.

member_rate.title: Member Rate
member_rate.description: True when the price is a member or loyalty rate that needs the guest signed in to the hotel's programme, false for a public rate, null when the source does not say. Member rates are listed so you see the hotel's full offer list; within a room they sort after public rates, and `POST /v2/bookings` accepts public rates only.

cancellation_deadline.title: Cancellation Deadline
cancellation_deadline.description: Last moment to cancel free of charge, RFC 3339; set only on offers read live, null otherwise.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: When the guest pays: `prepay` at booking or `pay_at_hotel` at the property; null when the source does not say.

occupancy.description: The party this price is for, totalled across all rooms.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: `available` when the room can be booked at this price, `sold_out` when the source showed it as unavailable, `unknown` when it did not say.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When this price was observed, RFC 3339 UTC.

url.title: Url
url.description: Page on the source where this price was observed; null when the source has no linkable page.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: One bookable price for one room and rate, as observed on a channel.

query_said.title: Query Said
query_said.description: The value read from the query, for example `Paris` or `2026-11-14/2026-11-16`.

filters_said.title: Filters Said
filters_said.description: The value from `filters`, which was used.

used.title: Used
used.description: Which value the search used; always `filters`.

Override.title: Override
Override.description: A conflict between the query text and `filters`, settled in favour of the filters.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `checkout` returns a hosted checkout link for pay-now offers, `handoff` returns a hosted browser session in which the guest completes the booking, `external` returns the booking engine's own prefilled page. `card_entry` (403 `not_yet_available` for a live key until enabled for the account; test keys run it in the sandbox) types the guest's card into the hotel's own checkout from a one-booking credential: send `payment_method` and `mandate`, then call `POST /v2/bookings/{booking_id}/confirm`. The hotel stays merchant of record.

return_url.title: Return Url
return_url.description: `checkout` only: the https page the guest lands on after paying (with `booking_id` appended) or abandoning; a VistaLink page when null.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: `checkout` only: language of the hosted checkout page as a language tag; `pt-BR` reads as `pt`, and unsupported languages fall back to the guest's browser.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description:
How the guest pays. The guest always pays the property directly; VistaLink never holds
the funds.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Opaque id of this request, also sent as the `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when contacting support.

billing.description: What this call cost, or null when it was free.

credential_id.title: Credential Id
credential_id.description: Credential id, `cred_` plus 24 letters and digits.

status.title: Status
status.description: `active` (unused), `bound` (attached to `booking_id`), `consumed` (handed to the hotel's checkout) or `deleted` (the vault token was deleted).

booking_id.title: Booking Id
booking_id.description: The booking it is bound to; null until then.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Card brand, for example `visa`; null when unknown.

last4.title: Last4
last4.description: Last four digits of the card.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the credential stops being usable: 30 minutes after creation, or the token's own expiry if sooner.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the credential was created, RFC 3339 UTC.

PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
PaymentCredential.description: A one-booking card credential. It never carries the card number or CVC.

bt_token_id.title: Bt Token Id
bt_token_id.description: The id of a Basis Theory `card` token you created with VistaLink's public key (type `card`, `expires_at` at most 60 minutes ahead, a fresh token per booking). The card number never reaches VistaLink. Test keys accept only `tok_test_confirmed`, `tok_test_requires_action`, `tok_test_card_declined`, `tok_test_unknown` and `tok_test_price_changed`.

credential_id.title: Credential Id
credential_id.description: A `cred_` id from `POST /v2/payment_credentials`, bound to this booking at create. Omit it to send it with `POST /v2/bookings/{booking_id}/confirm` instead.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description:
`card_entry` only: the card the hotel's engine charges, as a credential from
`POST /v2/payment_credentials`.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The policy in one or two sentences, in `locale` when translated.

structured.title: Structured
structured.description: The policy's terms as key-value data when the source gives them, for example times or age limits; shape depends on `kind`.

Policy.title: Policy
Policy.description: One hotel policy, such as children, pets or cancellation.

text.title: Text
text.description: Free-text taste, for example `romantic, great breakfast`, added to the semantic query; ignored when `ranking` is `filters`.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Short free-form tags such as `ROMANTIC`, up to 20, added to the semantic query and matched against review aspects.

Preferences.title: Preferences
Preferences.description: Soft signals that shape semantic ranking without excluding hotels.

total.title: Total
total.description: Price for the whole stay and party, a positive decimal string in `currency`.

PriceToBeat.title: PriceToBeat
PriceToBeat.description: A price you already hold for the same stay and party, which the hotel is asked to beat.

profile_source.title: Profile Source
profile_source.description: Main source of the published profile: `site` (the hotel's website) or `booking` (the third-party channel); null without a profile.

profile_updated_at.title: Profile Updated At
profile_updated_at.description: When the profile was last updated, RFC 3339 UTC.

images_release.title: Images Release
images_release.description: Id of the gallery release the image order comes from; null when the images section was not requested or the hotel is not in a release.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where the hotel's content comes from.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Id of the request that returned this quote; null in webhook payloads.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the quote is: `queued`, `contacting` (the email is going out), `waiting` (sent, awaiting the reply), `offer_received` (see `offers`), then `completed` (the deadline passed with offers), `accepted` (your guest was introduced), `no_response`, `declined`, `cancelled` or `failed`.

anchor.description: The price the hotel was asked to beat, or null when there was none.

deadline_at.title: Deadline At
deadline_at.description: When the hotel's time to reply ends, RFC 3339 UTC.

next_step.title: Next Step
next_step.description: One plain sentence on what happens next, suitable to show in your own interface.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the quote was requested, RFC 3339 UTC.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the quote last changed, RFC 3339 UTC.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Priced offers from the hotel's replies, oldest first.

accepted_offer_id.title: Accepted Offer Id
accepted_offer_id.description: The offer you accepted; null until `status` is `accepted`.

hotel_commission_applies.title: Hotel Commission Applies
hotel_commission_applies.description: After acceptance: true when the hotel pays a commission on the booking (half of it is yours), false when the offer was a special rate it pays no commission on; null before acceptance or when not yet known.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why the quote ended without offers when `status` is `failed` or `declined`: `no_contact_email`, `hotel_suppressed`, `hotel_daily_ceiling` (try again tomorrow), `invalid_stay`, `opted_out`, `unreachable` or `rejected`; null otherwise.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Always null on responses: the quote fee is charged once, when the hotel's first priced offer arrives, and shows in usage.

A request for a price quote, emailed to the hotel by VistaLink. Returned by create, get,
cancel and accept, and as `data` in `quote.updated`.

guest.description: The guest to introduce to the hotel.

total.title: Total
total.description: Price for the whole stay and party, a decimal string in `currency`.

nightly.title: Nightly
nightly.description: `total` divided by the number of nights.

source.title: Source
source.description: `third_party` when it is the best public online price we know, `partner` when you sent it.

QuoteAnchor.title: QuoteAnchor
QuoteAnchor.description: The price the hotel was asked to beat.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Guest's first name, up to 80 characters.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Guest's last name, up to 80 characters.

email.title: Email
email.description: Guest's email address; the guest is copied on the introduction email and the hotel replies to it.

QuoteGuest.title: QuoteGuest
QuoteGuest.description: The guest introduced to the hotel when you accept an offer.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: Offer id, `qof_` plus 20 hex characters; pass it to accept.

room_name.title: Room Name
room_name.description: Room the hotel offered, as it named it.

rate_name.title: Rate Name
rate_name.description: Short summary of the terms, for example `Breakfast included, free cancellation`.

total.title: Total
total.description: Price for the whole stay and party, a decimal string in `currency`.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the hotel quoted in; never converted.

nightly_avg.title: Nightly Avg
nightly_avg.description: `total` divided by the number of nights.

includes_taxes.title: Includes Taxes
includes_taxes.description: True when the hotel said taxes are included, false when not, null when it did not say.

board.title: Board
board.description: Meals included, or null when the hotel did not say.

free_cancellation.title: Free Cancellation
free_cancellation.description: True when the offer can be canceled free of charge, false when not, null when unknown.

cancellation_deadline.title: Cancellation Deadline
cancellation_deadline.description: Last moment to cancel free of charge, RFC 3339, when the hotel gave one.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: Last day the hotel holds this price, YYYY-MM-DD, when it said so.

offer_link.title: Offer Link
offer_link.description: A booking link the hotel included in its reply, or null.

beats_by.title: Beats By
beats_by.description: How much cheaper than the `anchor` price this offer is, in `currency`; null without a comparable anchor.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The sentence of the hotel's reply the price was read from, up to 280 characters.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the reading of the reply is, 0 to 1.

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: True when the reply was ambiguous and the price is being checked: show it with care, it cannot be accepted yet (409 `offer_needs_review`) and it is not charged for. The hotel's first offer with `needs_review` false is the one the quote fee is charged on.

QuoteOffer.title: QuoteOffer
QuoteOffer.description: One priced offer the hotel sent by email, read from its reply.

hotel_id.title: Hotel Id
hotel_id.description: The hotel to ask, as returned by resolve or search.

stay.description: Dates and party to ask about; `check_in` must be today or later.

wants.description: Room, board and cancellation preferences passed on to the hotel; omit to ask for the best rate.

price_to_beat.title: Price To Beat
price_to_beat.description: `auto` (the default) quotes the best public price we know for the stay as the price to beat, when there is one; `{total, currency}` uses your own price instead.

deadline_hours.title: Deadline Hours
deadline_hours.description: Hours the hotel has to reply, 1 to 168; default 48. A quote with no priced reply by then closes as `no_response` and costs nothing.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language of the email to the hotel, as a language tag such as `en` or `it`; the hotel's own language when omitted.

sandbox_outcome.title: Sandbox Outcome
sandbox_outcome.description: Test keys only: how the simulated hotel answers, `offer` (the default), `declined` or `no_response`. Rejected with 400 on a live key.

QuoteStay.title: QuoteStay
QuoteStay.description: The stay a quote asks about.

refundable.title: Refundable
refundable.description: True to ask for a rate with free cancellation, false for the cheapest non-refundable one.

board.title: Board
board.description: Meals to ask for: `none`, `breakfast`, `half` (breakfast and dinner), `full` (all meals) or `all_inclusive`.

room_type.title: Room Type
room_type.description: Room type to ask for in plain words, for example `double` or `junior suite`; up to 60 characters, no links, email addresses or angle brackets (it is quoted to the hotel).

QuoteWants.title: QuoteWants
QuoteWants.description:

preference, not a filter.

refundable.title: Refundable
refundable.description: Free cancellation asked for, or null.

room_type.title: Room Type
room_type.description: Room type asked for, or null.

QuoteWantsOut.title: QuoteWantsOut
QuoteWantsOut.description: The preferences sent with the quote request.

status.description: `observed` when seen recently (within 4 hours for stays in the next 14 days, else 24 hours) or `stale` when older but within 7 days; channels with no prices are left out.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the newest price on this channel was observed, RFC 3339 UTC.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Prices for each room and rate, cheapest first, sold-out last.

RateChannel.title: RateChannel
RateChannel.description: Prices from one channel for the requested stay.

hotel_id.description: The hotel's id; null when the input did not resolve.

input.title: Input
input.description: Index of the hotel in the request's `hotels[]`.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the input did not resolve, present only when `unresolved`; the `reason` `POST /v2/hotels/resolve` gives, for example `invalid_hotel_id` (neither a uuid nor a URL), `not_found`, or `not_indexed` (the listing exists but the hotel is not indexed yet).

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Code of the hotel's booking engine on the direct channel; null on the third-party channel and when unknown.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the newest price was observed, RFC 3339 UTC; null unless `observed` or `stale`.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Prices per room, cheapest room first; empty unless `observed` or `stale`.

room_id.title: Room Id
room_id.description: Catalogue room id when the source's room is matched to one; null otherwise.

name.title: Name
name.description: Room name as the source shows it.

listing_key.title: Listing Key
listing_key.description: The source's own key for the room.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: The cheapest offer per rate plan, cheapest first, sold-out last.

RateRoom.title: RateRoom
RateRoom.description: Prices for one room at a hotel.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.description: Up to 10,000 hotels, each a `hotel_id`, an inline identifier, or a listing or website URL as a string (the scheme is optional).

stays.title: Stays
stays.description: Up to 10 stays; every hotel is priced for every stay.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: `cached` reads stored prices; `live` reads the booking engines.

max_age_hours.title: Max Age Hours
max_age_hours.description: Oldest stored price to accept on `cached`, in hours; values above 168 are treated as 168.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Preferred ISO 4217 currency; prices are never converted.

hotels.title: Hotels

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: `direct` (the hotel's own booking engine, the default) or `third_party` (Enterprise only).

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: `cached` answers now from stored prices; `live` reads the booking engines and answers 202 with a job (Build plan or higher).

max_age_hours.title: Max Age Hours
max_age_hours.description: Oldest stored price to accept on `cached`, in hours; values above 168 (7 days) are treated as 168.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Preferred ISO 4217 currency; prices are never converted, and a `currency_not_converted` warning says when some differ.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Opaque id of this request, also sent as the `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when contacting support.

billing.description: What this call cost, or null when it was free.

results.title: Results
results.description: One result per entry in `hotels[]`, in request order.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Things the call could not fully do, such as `currency_not_converted`, `channel_unavailable`, `live_unavailable` or `live_partial`.

Response of `POST /v2/rates` with `freshness: cached`, and the `result` of a `rates.live`
job.

unknown.title: Unknown
unknown.description: Results with no prices for the stay.

unsupported.title: Unsupported
unsupported.description: Results whose hotel cannot be read on this channel.
